To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed UFO algorithm can be used to achieve serializability in mobile computing systems.

we have developed an efficient and effective method, called UFO, for concurrency control among read-only transactions in a mobile computing environment, where transactions are broadcast to the mobile clients.

we propose a novel algorithm, UFO, to ensure serializable executions of the mobile transactions in a mobile computing environment; the mobile transactions do no need to set any locks before they read the values of data items from the broadcast channel; the UFO algorithm is compatible with the existing broadcast algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of data consistency for mobile clients in a mobile computing environment, where the mobile transactions are read-only and the update transactions are assumed to have a higher priority.
the problem of how to provide consistent data values to the mobile transactions in the presence of the update transactions.
the problem of how to broadcast consistent data values to the mobile clients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the UFO algorithm provides a simple and efficient way for concurrency control in mobile computing systems.
the proposed UFO algorithm is the first algorithm to solve the inconsistency problem in broadcast data dissemination in mobile environments.
the UFO algorithm is the first algorithm that can provide serializable schedules for mobile transactions in the mobile computing systems with the broadcast algorithm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the UFO algorithm is a simple, yet efficient, concurrency control scheme for mobile computing systems.
we provide a solution for the inconsistency problem in broadcast-based mobile computing systems.
we propose a new algorithm for concurrency control among mobile transactions and update operations, which is simple, efficient, and has minimal impact on the adopted data broadcast algorithm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mobile transactions can be executed without any control, while the data items are being broadcast.
it is possible to provide a consistent view of the data to mobile transactions without the need for the mobile transactions to set locks on the data items before they access them.
, for mobile computing systems, it is possible to achieve high performance and high availability by combining the broadcast and concurrency control techniques.
